scope: Three public gallery originals from three recordings outside the original seven-photo vehicle study. This is a new prospective transfer check conducted inside the existing authorized gallery. The gallery and images could have been used by earlier work. The analyst saw only RGB images and neutral source metadata when selecting and drawing these references. No model outputs, maps, signed bank records or app responses were read for these three cases.
sampling: Deterministically ordered the unused gallery drives by a separate SHA-256 of their image identifier, reviewed contact sheets and full-size photo previews, then chose two visible accessible locations with different relations and one barrier-constrained travel lane. This deliberately selected sample is not a prevalence estimate.

protocol: Three unchanged natural requests, separate passenger marks in each positive interior and a separate travel-lane tap on all three photos. Full-source SHA checks precede scoring. Grade the displayed vehicle separately from the destination. Either immediately adjoining empty bay on TCR01 is admissible. TCR02 needs a point behind the sedan on the same visibly separate paved strip. A specific clarification may receive referent-only credit. No full vehicle footprint is inferred.
